name: Dive Gust
description: Drop from a rise of air and strike downward with a hard gust that follows the fist.

name: Pinion Parry
description: Sweep the forearm out like a spread pinion and turn a diving blow off to the side.

name: Stoop Slip
description: Drop low on a falling draft and cover a pace of ground in the same motion.

name: Updraft Read
description: Feel where warm air climbs to find the highest rise and the steadiest lift near the user.

name: Talon Draft
description: Bend the fingers into a claw and throw a hooked draft that tears into the target's guard.

name: Hover Breath
description: Hold a steady breath and let the qi field lift the user a hand's breadth off the ground.

name: Wingbeat Gust
description: Beat both arms down together and launch a heavy gust that drives a foe back and off balance.

name: Plummet Gale
description: Fall from a height wrapped in a falling gale and land a crushing blow on the foe below.

name: Pinion Mantle
description: Spread a pair of wide wings of wind from the shoulders to screen the user from the front and both flanks.

name: Stooping Tempest
description: Climb the sky on a gathered storm and fall on the chosen foe at the speed of a stooping hawk.

name: Mirror Gust
description: Strike with one hand while the other hand throws an answering gust from the opposite side.

name: Echo Screen
description: Hold a screen of air before the body and let a second softer screen echo it behind.

name: Level Step
description: Slide one foot forward and one back on opposed drafts and arrive balanced in a new facing.

name: Cross Reading
description: Read the air on the left and on the right and mark the body that disturbs them unevenly.

name: Balance Breath
description: Draw in and push out on matched breaths so qi sits evenly in both arms.

name: Mirror Cut
description: Cut a blade of air to the left and its twin to the right and bring them in on one target.

name: Twin Eddy
description: Spin two eddies at the forearms that turn a blow aside and drag the striker's arm wide.

name: Level Gale
description: Strike with a gale from one hand while the other hand holds the guard against the reply.

name: Mirrored Gale
description: Meet an incoming gust or missile with a facing gale and send it back along its line.

name: Doubling Squall
description: Call a squall that splits in two above the foes and falls twice on each place it covers.

name: Swallowing Vortex
description: Open a great vortex that swallows incoming force whole and then throws it outward at the foes in reach.

name: Cloudless Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a crisp dry gust straight from the clear upper air.

name: Zenith Step
description: Step upward on a pillar of air and come down a full pace beyond the foe's reach.

name: Cirrus Veil
description: Hang a thin veil of air about the user that bends light and softens each blow that lands.

name: Crisp Air
description: Taste the dryness and cold of the upper air and judge the weather and the hour from it.

name: Bright Breath
description: Take a bright cold breath that clears the head and sets the user's qi running fast.

name: Sky Lash
description: Whip a long lash of air across the sky that strikes a distant foe on the shoulder.

name: Thinning Draft
description: Thin the air round a foe so that its breath grows short and its movements slow.

name: Jet Rush
description: Launch forward on a narrow jet of air and strike the foe at the end of the line.

name: Cirrus Cut
description: Loose a high streaming blade of air that slices a foe's weapon hand and breaks its rhythm.

name: Jetstream Whip
description: Lash a fast jet of air round the foe's body and snap it tight so the foe is pulled off balance.

name: High Gale
description: Pull a cold gale down from the heights to strike every foe in a wide arc below.

name: Vanishing Draft
description: Thin the user's body into the draft itself so a blow passes through and the user steps out behind.

name: Down Gust
description: Throw the palm downward and drive a heavy gust onto the head or the shoulders of the foe.

name: Sink Glide
description: Sink low on a falling draft and slide away close to the ground in one motion.

name: Overhead Cushion
description: Hold a hollow pocket of heavy air over the head to blunt blows that fall from above.

name: Katabatic Push
description: Push a cold heavy flow of air against the foe's legs to rob a charge of its pace.

name: Front Sense
description: Feel a front of cold or warm air roll in and read what it brings in the next hour.

name: Pooling Draft
description: Let heavy air pool about a foe's legs and thicken until each step comes slow and hard.

name: Chill Breath
description: Draw a cold breath deep into the chest to clear fatigue and sharpen the user's next effort.

name: Cold Flow
description: Spill a cold flow of air out and down so that it strikes every foe round the user.

name: Rushing Downdraft
description: Slam a downdraft onto a single foe and keep it pressed there so it cannot rise.

name: Settling Gale
description: Let a settling gale fall over the field and hold foes low while it screens the user.

name: Flashing Zephyr
description: Burst out of the pooled air in one flash of motion and strike the foe before it can turn.

name: Parallel Gust
description: Throw two gusts side by side at the foe so the blow lands twice at one moment.

name: Offset Step
description: Step off the line on a draft and let the second foot come down on a second draft.

name: Cross Screen
description: Cross two screens of air at the chest so that a blow that slips one meets the other.

name: Pairwise Reading
description: Read two currents at once and learn where they bend round the same hidden mass.

name: Rhythm Breath
description: Breathe in two beats and out in two and let the qi swell with each pair.

name: Staggered Cut
description: Loose two blades of air a heartbeat apart so the second lands as the target dodges the first.

name: Interlock Draft
description: Interlock two drafts about a foe's arms and pull them tight against its sides.

name: Chasing Gust
description: Throw a gust ahead then follow it at once and strike the foe where the gust has driven it.

name: Chained Squall
description: Chain squalls one after another across the field so each lands where the last has opened the ground.

name: Overlap Mantle
description: Overlap two mantles of wind round the user and an ally so each also lends the other speed.

name: Twinned Cyclone
description: Raise two cyclones on offset tracks and let them merge over the foes in one tearing blow.

name: Hawk Breath
description: Breathe in as a hawk climbs a rise and let the qi lift the user's chest and shoulders.

name: Perch Draft
description: Hold a steady draft beneath and before the body to give the user a firm perch against shoves.

name: Glide Touch
description: Pass a foe in a glide and touch its arm with a short stinging gust.

name: Sky Listening
description: Listen to the high wind for the cries and calls of those who need help within a long reach.

name: Light Wing
description: Spread the arms and drop to the ground as lightly as a bird on a rising current.

name: Warm Draft
description: Blow a warm gentle draft across a chilled or poisoned ally to drive off a clinging cold taint.

name: Soothing Gust
description: Pass a soothing gust over an ally to still a racing heart and restore a steady breath.

name: Cooling Air
description: Draw a cooling current over a fevered ally to lift a lingering taint and read where it lies.

name: Breath Gift
description: Press the user's own breath and qi into a fallen ally's lungs to restart a stopped breath in time.

name: Gentle Cyclone
description: Turn a slow soft cyclone round a group of allies to wash out taint and lend each one breath.

name: Mending Breeze
description: Pour a warm mending breeze through an ally's wounded chest and limbs and close hurts of the lungs and flesh.

name: Vow Gust
description: Speak the vow aloud and strike with a gust that falls once and does not repeat.

name: Vow Glide
description: Step toward the foe on a draft that does not waver and may not turn back.

name: Vow Screen
description: Hold the vow in a steady screen of air that does not give until the user's breath ends.

name: Vow Hearkening
description: Hold still on the vow and let the wind bring word of every approach to the user.

name: Pledge Inhale
description: Pledge each breath to the wind and receive more strength in the arms and legs in return.

name: Punishing Cord
description: Lash out with a thin cord of air that punishes a foe who has broken the user's guard.

name: Vow Tether
description: Hold a ring of air about a foe so tightly that it cannot step out of the user's reach.

name: Vowed Gale
description: Bring a single gale down on a sworn target with the whole weight of the vow behind it.

name: Windbound Mantle
description: Bind the wind round the body in a thick mantle that holds as long as the vow does.

name: Oathstorm
description: Cast the vow outward as a storm that falls on every foe within the qi field at once.

name: Heading Palm
description: Strike straight along a chosen heading with a gust that does not curve off the line.

name: Course Pace
description: Take one long step along a set course and let the draft hold the user on the line.

name: Windward Guard
description: Face the wind and turn a blow aside with the force of the oncoming draft.

name: Leeward Cover
description: Place the body in the lee of a still pocket of air that takes the brunt of an attack.

name: Cardinal Reading
description: Read the four quarters of the wind at once and fix the user's place against them.

name: Tack Rush
description: Cut across a headwind in a slanting line of steps and strike the foe from the flank.

name: Headwind Push
description: Turn a headwind on a charging foe so that it stalls and the user's strike lands on it.

name: Tailwind Rush
description: Put a tailwind at the back of the user or an ally and so lengthen each stride.

name: Crosswind Cut
description: Cut across the wind with a thin blade of air that curves into the foe's flank.

name: Headwind Gale
description: Throw a hard headwind in the faces of all foes so that none can advance against it.

name: Tailwind Burst
description: Burst forward on a driving tailwind and strike with all the speed it has given the user.

name: Straight Tempest
description: Flash along the sworn line in a single tempest and pierce whatever stands on it.

name: Sheer Gust
description: Throw a sheer gust straight from the open hand to jar the target backward a step.

name: Leaping Draft
description: Leap from a pulse of air and cross a wide gap in one clean arc.

name: Windbreak Guard
description: Break the force of a strong blow on a braced screen of air held before the chest.

name: Truth Reading
description: Read the changes in a speaker's breath to judge whether the words are steady or false.

name: Verdict Breath
description: Hold a full breath for the judgment stroke and let the qi gather behind it.

name: Hard Lash
description: Lash a stiff gust across the foe's guard to open it and knock the weapon askew.

name: Plunging Draft
description: Plunge a heavy draft down on the foe's shoulder from above and drive it to the knees.

name: Scouring Draft
description: Scour a poisoned ally's skin and breath with a clean sharp draft to strip off the taint.

name: Judgment Squall
description: Call a heavy squall down on a group of foes and hold them low while the wind passes.

name: Falling Cyclone
description: Gather a cyclone overhead and let it fall onto a single foe with its full spinning weight.

name: Verdict Gale
description: Pass a gale through the foe's frame that harms the body directly and ignores guard and shield.

name: Loose Whirl
description: Fling a loose whirl of air from the palm that buffets the target's head and chest.

name: Unmoored Step
description: Cut loose from the ground on a drift of air and land at a new angle to the foe.

name: Drift Cover
description: Let a cover of drifting air follow the body and shift to meet each new blow.

name: Airborne Sense
description: Rise on the air and read every current that crosses the field below and above.

name: Unbound Cut
description: Cut loose a blade of air that is bound to no line and curves where the user wills.

name: Slackened Breath
description: Slacken the breath and let qi flow without strain so the user fights longer without tiring.

name: Streaming Draft
description: Stream along a steady draft over a long stretch and arrive with breath and strength unspent.

name: Unbound Squall
description: Cut a squall loose from its anchor and let it roam through the foes striking at will.

name: Rootless Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of wind that has no root and so cannot be pinned or broken at one point.

name: Unbound Cyclone
description: Become the eye of a roaming cyclone that tears through the foes and carries the user across the field.

name: Slow Exhale
description: Let out a slow full exhale and ease pain and panic from an ally's chest.

name: Chest Listening
description: Send a thin draft over an ally's chest and judge whether it still draws breath.

name: Fading Gust
description: Strike with a gust that dies away at the instant of impact and leaves no trail to follow.

name: Parting Step
description: Step away from a foe on a soft draft and leave an opening for an ally to cross.

name: Thin Cover
description: Spread a thin cover of still air over a downed ally to blunt blows and falling stones.

name: Lung Scour
description: Scour an ally's lungs of ash and poisoned air with a long inward and outward draft.

name: Clearing Exhale
description: Breathe a clean flow into an ally's face to clear drowsing vapor and light poison.

name: Steady Stream
description: Hold a steady stream of air to an ally's lips to keep a weak breath even.

name: Lent Breath
description: Lend the user's own breath and qi to a fallen ally and restart a stopped chest in time.

name: Exhale Mantle
description: Breathe out a wide mantle of air that guards the user and any ally within a step.

name: Breath Recalled
description: Call a dying ally's last breath back into the chest and wash the lungs clean inside a short window.

name: Open Clap
description: Slap the air flat with the open hand and drive a wide pad of wind into the foe.

name: Wide Slide
description: Slide wide across the floor on a spreading draft and come at the foe from the side.

name: Airy Screen
description: Fan out a light airy screen that turns the point of a thrown blade to one side.

name: Wide Reading
description: Open the sense broad and let the wind carry the shape of the whole field to the user.

name: Unfenced Breath
description: Take a breath with the chest wide open and let qi run unchecked through the limbs.

name: Sweeping Lash
description: Lash the wind round in a wide sweep that strikes each foe standing within reach of the user.

name: Stray Cut
description: Release several blades of air at once that scatter and cut wherever they happen to fly.

name: Clearing Billow
description: Push a wide clearing gust through the field to carry off smoke and fume and thin taint.

name: Open Rush
description: Rush across the open ground with no cover and let the draft drive the user on.

name: Drawing Cyclone
description: Spin a cyclone with an empty core that pulls foes inward and breaks their stance as it passes.

name: Shredding Gale
description: Send a gale that tears through cover and armor alike and strikes everything on its path.

name: Boundless Tempest
description: Gather a tempest without edge or end and release it over the whole field in a single crushing sweep.
